issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation uses 'hay' (or) to connect the three types of people, but the Greek 'η... η... ος' functions as a cumulative list (and/as well as). More importantly, the Vietnamese translates 'πλεονεκτης' (exploiter/greedy person) as 'kẻ tham lam' (greedy person) and then adds '(tức là kẻ thờ hình tượng)' in parentheses. In the Greek text, 'ειδωλολατρης' (idolater) is a separate category in the list, not a definition or appositive of 'πλεονεκτης'. The Vietnamese structure implies that the exploiter IS the idolater, whereas the Greek lists them as three distinct types of people.
